figs.cap: (upper panels) depict MSF for the 4 arrangments, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄. Namely, notice the drastic contrast in the MSF patterns as the arrangement is stretched. (lower panels) display typical collective spin configuration for each of these arrangements. MSF has been computed using a 120× 120 points matrix covering an area of qₓ,q_y in the interval [-6π,6π].

MSF of low-energy states along the blue line from Fig. 3. Four different values of (ℓ/b, a/b) are taken: (a) (0.272, 1.7), (b) (0.646, 1.5), (c) (0.819, 1.3), and (d) (0.943, 1.1). [MSF is evaluated over a 120× 120 matrix covering an area of qₓ,q_y in the interval (-6π,6π)].
